judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the initial planning/red-test phase: it added `.lore/dod.md`, `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`. It never actually implemented the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, all four new acceptance tests fail immediately when run against the unchanged codebase. Furthermore, none of the required unit tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`, `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) or documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were delivered.
